subject: Cisco SG350 Router RTR-0035-01 Completely Offline at Madhapur
description: The Cisco SG350 router (RTR-0035-01) at ServeWell - Madhapur store is completely offline and unresponsive. All Wi-Fi connectivity and wired network connections are down, affecting point-of-sale systems and customer operations. The device shows no power indicators or LED activity. Basic power cycle has not resolved the issue. Store staff attempted a restart approximately 10 minutes ago without success.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and assigned to network support queue. Confirmed with store that power cable connections are secure and outlet is functional. Pending remote diagnostics.
